universe_a_schedule_only.description: Pre-event calendar risk conditioning without look-ahead to release values or post-event prices
universe_a_schedule_only.authorized_use: Volatility anticipation, precautionary risk reduction, stop-loss expansion

universe_b_post_publication.description: Execution strictly at first 5m candle open after t_published + uncertainty_seconds
universe_b_post_publication.authorized_use: Descriptive volatility expansion and regime transition research only. Directional trading PROHIBITED.

safe_execution_candle_methodology.rule: t_safe = t_published + uncertainty_seconds; exec_candle = min { candle_open >= t_safe }

scientific_conclusions: 1. STRICT DUAL UNIVERSES: Schedule-only universe (217 events) isolates calendar awareness from post-announcement information.
2. UNCERTAINTY UPPER BOUND: Every safe execution candle is scheduled strictly after t_published + timestamp_uncertainty_seconds, preventing execution at pre-release prices.
3. ZERO CLOSE LEAKAGE: In 100% of events, execution is anchored to candle Open, completely avoiding intra-candle close leakage.

4. DIRECTIONAL SIGNAL QUARANTINE: Because survey consensus remains unverified, directional post-release trading eligibility is set to ZERO (0 records), isolating research to descriptive volatility only.
